about: Check-ins tab (the athlete, Nov 1, 2026): the surveys that feed Health Pillars, by cadence. Definitions only. Answers are saved by the page to the dashboard store as checkin/<survey>-<period> documents {survey, period, answers: {qid: value}, saved_at}; the morning run ingests them with coach/tools/checkins.py into coach/checkins.csv (and health.json for nicotine, the physical, BP, labs and self-tests). Periods: weekly = the Monday's date, monthly YYYY-MM, quarterly YYYY-Qn, half YYYY-H1/H2, yearly YYYY. Every question is optional; a skipped answer is unknown, never zero. Daily and after-session check-ins are the existing feel_daily and feel_sessions forms.

questions.q: Scale extras (if your scale shows them)
questions.hint: From the scale app's detail screen. Skip if you don't have them.

Sit-to-rise: from standing, sit cross-legged on the floor and stand up; start at 10, minus 1 per hand, knee or forearm support, minus 0.5 per wobble; best of two. One-leg stand: barefoot, hands on hips, eyes open, up to 30 s; record the weaker leg. Grip: only with a hand dynamometer, best of 3, stronger hand.
